D: Ace Ventura travels to Africa to find a sacred white bat and stop a war between two tribes.
P: Serve the mains when Ace lands in Africa.
S: Safari camp beef samosas with mint yoghurt
Crisp fried triangles of curried beef, carrot and peas, mint yoghurt

Crisp East African style samosas filled with spiced beef mince, onion and coriander, served with a cool mint yoghurt dip and lemon wedges. Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves until browned. Add 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 grated carrot and 100g peas and cook 5 minutes. Stir through chopped coriander and cool. Cut 6 spring roll wrappers into 3 strips each, place a spoon of filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of salt for dipping.
Monastery momos with chilli tomato sauce
Steamed pork and ginger dumplings with fresh chilli tomato sauce

Steamed Tibetan dumplings filled with pork, ginger and spring onion, served with a fiery tomato and chilli dipping sauce. Mix 400g pork mince with 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Place a teaspoon in the centre of each of 24 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water for 10 minutes. For the sauce, blitz 2 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, 1 garlic clove, a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp vinegar and simmer 5 minutes.
M: Lemon chilli grilled chicken, chapati and tomato kachumbari salad

Chilli, lemon and garlic marinated chicken thighs grilled with char, served with soft pan-fried chapati and a fresh tomato and red onion kachumbari. Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets with the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. For chapati, mix 300g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil and 180ml warm water, knead and rest 20 minutes, then roll into 8 rounds and dry-fry 1 minute a side. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Toss 3 diced tomatoes, 1 red onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari.
Wachootoo sweet potato and peanut stew
Brought to the peace feast between the Wachati and the Wachootoo

Sweet potato, tomato and spinach simmered in a spiced peanut sauce, over rice with lime and roasted peanuts. Soften the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and cumin in the oil. Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice. Stir through the spinach until wilted. Serve over rice with lime and chopped peanuts.
W: Fluffy East African doughnuts made with coconut milk and cardamom, fried golden and dusted in sugar, with a little bowl of honey for dipping. Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp ground cardamom and a pinch of salt. Stir in 200ml coconut milk and 1 egg to make a soft dough, knead 2 minutes and rest 15 minutes. Roll out to 1cm thick and cut into 16 triangles. Fry in oil at 170C for 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden. Drain and toss in 60g caster sugar. Serve warm with honey.
K: Passionfruit, lime and ginger syrup over crushed ice with soda

Fresh passionfruit pulp shaken with lime, a little sugar syrup and ginger, topped with soda water over crushed ice with mint. Heat 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and a few slices of fresh ginger until dissolved, then cool and strain. Scoop the pulp from 6 passionfruit into a jug. Add the juice of 3 limes and the ginger syrup and stir well. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice, divide the passionfruit mix between them and top each with 200ml soda water. Stir and finish with mint sprigs.

dishes.n: Safari camp beef samosas with mint yoghurt
dishes.make_ahead: Filled samosas up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the mince, onion and garlic until browned. Add the curry powder, garam masala, carrot and peas and cook, then stir through the coriander and cool.
Cut the wrappers into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint and a pinch of salt for dipping.
Serve the samosas hot with the mint yoghurt.

veg.n: Safari camp potato and pea samosas with mint yoghurt
veg.make_ahead: Filled samosas up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender and drain.
Fry the onion and garlic in the tablespoon of oil until soft. Add the curry powder, garam masala, carrot, peas and potatoes and cook, lightly crushing, then stir through the coriander and cool.
Cut the wrappers into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water.
Fry in the oil for frying at 180C until golden, working in batches.
Mix the yoghurt with the mint and a pinch of salt for dipping and serve with the hot samosas.

dishes.n: Monastery momos with chilli tomato sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Fill and pleat the momos up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled on a lined tray under a damp cloth; make the sauce up to 3 days ahead

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Mix the pork with the ginger, two of the garlic cloves, spring onions, soy and sesame oil.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water.
Blitz the tomatoes, chillies, remaining garlic, salt and vinegar, then simmer to make the sauce.

veg.n: Monastery mushroom and tofu momos with chilli tomato sauce
veg.make_ahead: Cook the mushroom and tofu filling up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; pleat the momos and steam on the night, and make the sauce up to 3 days ahead

ingredients.item: garlic cloves, 2 crushed for the filling and 1 for the sauce

steps.text: Fry the finely chopped mushrooms in the vegetable oil until dry and browned, then cool and mix with the crumbled tofu, ginger, two of the garlic cloves, spring onions, soy and sesame oil.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water for 10 minutes.
Blitz the tomatoes, chillies, remaining garlic, salt and vinegar, then simmer to make the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate the chicken up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; make the chapati dough and kachumbari on the night

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with the lemon juice, garlic, chilli flakes, paprika, some of the oil and salt.
Marinate in the fridge.
Mix the flour, salt, remaining oil and warm water into a dough, knead, then rest.
Roll the dough into rounds and dry-fry each side in a hot pan.
Grill the chicken, turning once, until cooked through.
Toss the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari and serve with the chicken and chapati.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate the haloumi up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; make the chapati and grill on the night

steps.text: Mix the lemon juice, garlic, chilli flakes, paprika and some of the oil and coat the haloumi.
Leave the haloumi to marinate while you make the chapati.
Mix the flour, salt, remaining oil and warm water into a dough, knead, then rest.
Roll the dough into rounds and dry-fry each side in a hot pan.
Grill the haloumi, turning once, until golden and charred.
Toss the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari and serve with the haloumi and chapati.

dishes.n: Wachootoo sweet potato and peanut stew
dishes.make_ahead: Stew up to 3 days ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Soften the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and cumin in the oil.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, peanut butter and stock and simmer until tender. Meanwhile cook the rice.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice with lime and chopped peanuts.

dishes.make_ahead: Mix and rest the dough up to 4 hours ahead, covered; roll and fry just before serving

steps.text: Mix the flour, half the sugar, cardamom and a pinch of salt. Stir in the coconut milk and egg to a soft dough, then knead briefly.
Rest the dough.
Roll out 1cm thick and cut into triangles.
Fry in oil at 170C, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain and toss in the remaining sugar.
Serve warm with honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and cool the ginger syrup up to 5 days ahead in the fridge; mix with the passionfruit, lime and soda to order

steps.text: Heat the sugar with water and ginger until dissolved, then cool and strain.
Scoop the passionfruit pulp into a jug and add the lime juice and ginger syrup.
Fill glasses with crushed ice, divide the passionfruit mix between them and top with soda water.
Stir and finish with mint.
